description: This file defines an abstract base class for Workflow type plugins in Drupal, providing methods for managing workflow states and transitions, including adding, deleting, and sorting states and transitions, as well as handling dependencies.

classes.name: WorkflowTypeBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for workflow type plugins, providing core functionality for managing workflow states and transitions within Drupal.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the label of the workflow plugin, typically a translatable string.

methods.name: workflowHasData
methods.description: Indicates whether the workflow has associated data; default is FALSE.

methods.name: workflowStateHasData
methods.description: Indicates whether a specific state within the workflow has data; default is FALSE.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the plugin configuration array, merging with default configuration.

methods.name: getRequiredStates
methods.description: Returns the list of required states as defined in plugin definition.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for states and transitions.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates dependencies; default returns an empty array.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles removal of dependencies; default returns FALSE.

methods.name: getInitialState
methods.description: Returns the initial state of the workflow.

methods.name: addState
methods.description: Adds a new state to the workflow with validation.

methods.name: hasState
methods.description: Checks if a state exists in the workflow.

methods.name: getStates
methods.description: Retrieves all states, optionally filtered by IDs, sorted by label and weight.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves a specific state object by ID.

methods.name: setStateLabel
methods.description: Updates the label of a specified state.

methods.name: setStateWeight
methods.description: Updates the weight of a specified state.

methods.name: deleteState
methods.description: Removes a state from the workflow, along with related transitions.

methods.name: addTransition
methods.description: Adds a transition between states with validation.

methods.name: getTransitions
methods.description: Retrieves all transitions, optionally filtered by IDs, sorted by label and weight.

methods.name: getTransition
methods.description: Retrieves a specific transition object by ID.

methods.name: hasTransition
methods.description: Checks if a transition exists.

methods.name: getTransitionsForState
methods.description: Retrieves transitions associated with a specific state.

methods.name: getTransitionFromStateToState
methods.description: Retrieves a transition object from one state to another.

methods.name: hasTransitionFromStateToState
methods.description: Checks if a transition exists from one state to another.

methods.name: setTransitionLabel
methods.description: Updates the label of a transition.

methods.name: setTransitionWeight
methods.description: Updates the weight of a transition.

methods.name: setTransitionFromStates
methods.description: Sets the 'from' states for a transition with validation.

methods.name: deleteTransition
methods.description: Removes a transition.

methods.name: getTransitionIdFromStateToState
methods.description: Finds the transition ID connecting two states.

methods.name: getNextWeight
methods.description: Calculates the next weight value for new states or transitions.
